reviews.review: This game is do bad !!!!! i hate it and want something els.

I just feel that the game is a waste of money i bought it expecting the developers to finish the game but instead they just gave up on it instead. this game is probably the best example of a scam there is so unless you like games that are unplayable and never will be in a playable state then go ahead and get the game.

Such a simple game with simple graphics (maybe good for a chillout session), but totally unplayable on nVidia PC gaming setups, lots of FPS drops. Lacks the necessary optimization. I don't recommend playing on PC until the developers fix it. For comparison Deathloop on Ultra setting 300+ FPS, Redfall on the other hand Lowest setting 15-30 (sometimes 70) FPS. AND Deathloop has much more complex graphics and mechanics than Redfall. So it strikes me as a joke. :-( Even you can't do silent kill from behind, WTF? Kinda sad that it is same studio but HUGE differencies. Just turn off stewpid grass/leaves/trees animations at least which are totally useless...

EDIT due react:
PC specs (Windows 11 Pro 64-bit, nVidia RTX 2060-6GB Max-P which supports DirectX 12_2 Ultimate, Intel i7-1165G7 with 12M Cache, up to 4.70 GHz, 64 GB RAM DDR4 3200 MHz, SSD 2x2TB Samsung 990 Pro NVMe M.2, latest drivers on all componets). So where is the problem? All the triple-A games that have come out recently have no problem running smoothly on my PC build at FullHD 1080p presets (mostly full high/ultra details) => around 100+FPS, BUT Redfall even at the lowest settings does not :-/. And as I mentioned compared to Deathloop, where this previous game runs sooo smooth with plenty of FPS. So problem is somewhere else and reinstall it into Windows 10 just for one game is pretty ridiculous. (BTW my Steam overlay is always Off, nVidia overlay too... BTW I'm no ordinary PC user, I can tweak too, but this game is just poorly ported and it needs more polishing for run smootly right out of the box). If you haven't noticed, that's why you have so many negative reviews. Because of this.
